tasks.short: Locate and review research articles and technical reports

steps.what: State the question and name known research articles
Locate technical reports in the bibliographic index
Rank environmental and historical abstracts against seeds

loop.input: abstracts, seed article ids, and the reason each seed is relevant
loop.output: an ordered queue with a one-line reason per abstract
loop.check: held-out known-relevant seeds stay above the stop line, and a reason that does not mention the screening question fails
loop.stop: she stops labelling when the pre-set yield drop is hit or the label budget is spent; fewer than three seeds and this step does not run
loop.why_not_simpler: a keyword list does not reorder abstracts by likely relevance to the question

steps.what: Review abstracts until the stop rule fires
Read included research articles in full
Write what the reports mean for this site

tasks.design: She states the question and the seed articles in {DOCS}. A pull from the bibliographic index in {OTHER} replaces paging that index by hand, and a bounded ranker replaces her reordering of abstracts. She still labels until the stop rule, reads the kept articles, and writes the site note. The note is not sent, and saving it in {DOCS} is not removed work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Abstract piles were too uneven for a keyword list, and a summary was not safe to treat as inclusion.
tasks.enabler_now: A ranker can reorder abstracts against seeds she names, with a stop rule tested on known-relevant records.
tasks.still_hard: Historical reports without an abstract still have to be fetched and read by her.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what the kept reports mean for this site.

ambition.what: Rebuild the reading queue the same week a new borehole question arrives.

tasks.altitude: She still frames the question, labels until the stop rule, reads what she keeps, and writes the site note. Paging the index and reordering the pile leave that week.

reach.learn: Write a screening question with seed articles and a stop rule, and hold known-relevant records out of the labels.

evidence.claim: ASReview LAB reorders abstracts while a person screens, for locating and reviewing research articles. This design copies that pattern: the model ranks and she labels.
Scopus AI writes abstract summaries of up to 20 papers, and the vendor warns against relying on them alone, so this design does not treat a summary as inclusion.

On one published review of 5,808 references, ASReview found all 28 included studies after 746 records, 92 minutes against 1,018 manual. Independent academics, one dataset. Those minutes are not this organisation's saving.
In 84 generated literature reviews, 55 percent of one model's references and 18 percent of a later model's were fabricated, so she reads the kept articles and writes the note herself.
If the label log names her and could be used to check performance, the digest cites Dutch works-council consent. Other countries follow their own national rules.

assumptions: Seed fields she writes in s1 are article id, title, and why it is relevant. The bibliographic index in {OTHER} returns report id, title, year, and abstract. She is the producer. If fewer than three seeds are named, s3 does not run and she labels the full report list.

The work removed is paging the index and reordering abstracts. The stop rule, fixed before labelling and tested on held-out known-relevant seeds, shortens only the abstract queue in s4. Full-text reading stays. A save of the site note in {DOCS} is not a step and is not a saving.
She keeps the seed list and the stop threshold. That upkeep is her time, counted once below.
unknowns: Whether the bibliographic index returns an abstract and a stable id for the reports she actually uses.
research_questions: Which index does she page today, and does it allow a bulk export of abstracts?

already_counted.description: Framing the question, labelling until the stop rule, reading kept articles, and writing the site note remain her time in s1, s4, s5 and s6.

incremental.description: She keeps the seed article list and the stop threshold. That upkeep is her time.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Fewer than three seeds means ranking does not run and she labels the full pile, so the saving falls toward the index pull. Reports with no abstract are still fetched by hand. The published screening minutes are one dataset and are not this saving. A save of the note in {DOCS} is not counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write papers, speak at conferences, and teach geology

steps.what: Read geological findings before the research papers
Decide the claims the writing will defend
Draft the paper text from that evidence pack

loop.input: the evidence pack: claim sentence, number, unit, citation id, source page
loop.output: manuscript prose that uses only those claims
loop.check: every number and unit appears in the claim sentence she wrote, and a sentence that adds a finding not in the pack fails
loop.stop: any miss stops the draft and she writes that passage herself
loop.why_not_simpler: a fixed paragraph cannot carry her claims in full sentences

steps.what: Check every number and citation in the draft
Re-enter the checked manuscript in the journal portal
Communicate findings while participating in conferences
Keep teaching geological science at universities

tasks.design: She writes an evidence pack in {DOCS} with each claim, number, unit, citation and source page, and a bounded draft uses only that pack. She checks every number and citation. The only outgoing work removed is the re-entry of that checked text into the journal portal in {OTHER}. Conference talks and teaching stay with her, and a save inside {DOCS} is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prose had to follow her claims, and generated citations are often wrong, so an open draft was not usable.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can be limited to a pack she wrote, and stopped when a sentence adds a finding that is not in it.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the claims, speaks at conferences, and teaches.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the claims and checks every number against the source page.
tasks.altitude: She still decides the claims, checks the draft, speaks, and teaches. Sentence drafting from her pack, and the portal re-entry of the text she checked, leave the week.

reach.task: Communicate research findings in a paper
reach.learn: Bind the portal re-entry to the evidence pack she checked, including each number, unit and source page.

evidence.claim: Teaching and conference participation stay with the person. That matches the digest line that teaching stays manual. Model knowledge.
In 84 generated literature reviews, 55 percent of one model's references and 18 percent of a later model's were fabricated, so a sentence that adds a finding outside her pack fails.

Article 50(4) says AI text that informs the public, such as weather or climate briefs, is disclosed unless a person reviews it under editorial responsibility. She reviews the manuscript before the portal re-entry, and the assist is disclosed. The digest's example is weather or climate briefs.

assumptions: If the site review note from the literature task is missing, s1 uses her field notes. The evidence pack she writes in s2 has claim sentence, number, unit, citation id and source page. A number with no source page is omitted from the draft.

The journal portal in {OTHER} is a second system from {DOCS}. The work removed in s5 is that re-entry of the checked manuscript, not a save of the file where she wrote it. If she submits no paper in the period, s5 does not run. Talks use the findings brief, not the unsent draft.
She keeps the section order of the manuscript. That upkeep is her time, counted once below.
unknowns: Whether her journal submission is a separate portal from {DOCS}, or she only keeps the file where she wrote it.
research_questions: How often she actually submits a manuscript, against weeks that are only teaching and conferences.

already_counted.description: Reading findings, writing the pack, checking the draft, speaking at conferences, and teaching remain her time in s1, s2, s4, s6 and s7.

incremental.description: She keeps the section order of the manuscript. That upkeep is her time.

approvals.approved_version: The manuscript text she checked in s4, bound to the evidence pack: claim sentences, numbers, units, citation ids and source pages. Any later edit voids the portal re-entry.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month of teaching and conferences with no manuscript removes nothing. The high is a one-paper month where only part of the prose is replaced. The five points are only the re-entry into the journal portal. A save inside {DOCS} is not counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and conduct field studies, sampling, and drilling

steps.what: Read prior research notes for this application
Decide the plan for these field studies
Conduct geological geochemical and geophysical field studies
Run sample collection and collect during surveys
Direct drilling and testing programs on site

tasks.design: She reads prior notes, decides the field plan, and conducts the studies, sampling and drilling herself. No list is copied into a second system, and no send is added. Fieldwork stays with her.
tasks.previous_blocker: The site, the samples and the drilling are physical work with no stable digital substitute.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing documented removes fieldwork, so the honest change is none.
tasks.still_hard: Judging where to drill stays with her on the site.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the plan and conducts the program.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still plans the work and stands on the site.

reach.task: Collect samples during a field survey
reach.learn: Follow the plan she decided on site. This task does not produce a generated program for them.

evidence.claim: Field studies, sample collection and drilling stay with the person. That is model knowledge, consistent with the digest line that fieldwork stays manual. No machine step is added to avoid a zero.

assumptions: No structured handoff is produced for a later machine. Sample id, coordinate, depth, unit and measurement are written by her during the program for the mapping task, and that writing stays inside these steps.
No second list is maintained, and a save of the field plan in {DOCS} is not removed work. Upkeep hours are zero for that reason.
unknowns: Whether the employer requires any written program beyond the plan she already makes on site.
research_questions: Who besides her handles the drill rig, and is that time already outside this role?

already_counted.description: Reading notes, deciding the plan, and conducting studies, sampling and drilling remain entirely her time.

incremental.description: No second list is kept. Hours are zero because no upkeep is added.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Field studies, sampling and drilling stay with her. No second copy and no send are treated as removed work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare maps, charts, and reports from field results

steps.what: Read fieldwork and laboratory research results
Mark geological contacts on cross sectional diagrams
Prepare maps and charts using those contacts
Check each chart against the borehole results
Write reports concerning mineral extraction land use and resource management

tasks.design: She reads the fieldwork and laboratory results and marks the contacts herself. A script in {DOCS} draws the maps and charts from only those contacts, and that drawing is the work removed. She checks each chart and writes the report. The report is not entered in a second system, and saving it in {DOCS} is not counted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contacts were interpreted as she drew, so a plot from raw rows would have traced the wrong lines.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she marks contact, depth and unit, a script can trace only those points.
tasks.still_hard: Results with no coordinate or unit still have to be drawn by her.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which contacts are real and what the report claims.
tasks.altitude: She still interprets the contacts and writes the report. Only the trace of contacts she has already marked leaves the week.

reach.task: Read a land use chart before advising
reach.learn: Use only charts whose contacts the geoscientist marked, and treat a missing coordinate as not plotted.

evidence.claim: Once she has marked contact id, borehole ids, depth and unit, plotting those points is a fixed trace. Model knowledge. The digest describes scripted pipelines for charts from data samples, not a second filing step.
Copernicus openEO reruns scripts over satellite datacubes for land cover maps. That input is not her sample contacts, so it is not used here.

assumptions: Result rows come from the field program and the lab report, with sample id, coordinate, depth, unit and measurement. She marks contacts in s2: contact id, borehole ids, depth and unit. s3 draws only those contacts. A point with no coordinate or unit is skipped and she draws it.
The work removed is the drawing of the chart. The report is not copied into another system. A save of the report in {DOCS} is not a step and is not a saving.
She keeps unit names and legend colours. That upkeep is her time, counted once below.
unknowns: Whether sample id, coordinate, depth, unit and measurement are already written on the field notes and the lab report.
research_questions: How often the results are narrative only, with no coordinate or unit to plot?

already_counted.description: Reading results, marking contacts, checking charts and writing the report remain her time in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: She keeps unit names and legend colours. That upkeep is her time.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Results with no coordinate or unit mean the script draws nothing and she draws those points. The saving is only the trace of contacts she already marked, not a later save of the report.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still frames the question, reads the papers she keeps, writes the claims, teaches, and stands on the site. Paging the index, reordering abstracts, a checked portal re-entry, and drawing charts from marked contacts leave the week. Field programs stay with her.
reach: Environmental scientists reuse a screening question that names seed articles and a stop rule, and they learn to hold known-relevant records out of the labels.
Geological technicians follow the field plan she decides on site; this work does not hand them a generated program.
skills_to_grow: Write a screening question with seed articles and a stop rule tested on known-relevant records.
Check a plotted contact against the borehole depth and unit before the report uses it.
role.ambitious_version: No unattended agent chooses the papers, signs the map, teaches, or decides where to drill.
